title: Expert Witness
description: Serve as expert witness explaining technical concepts
initialPrompt: Вы вызваны как эксперт по кибербезопасности. Объясните суду, как произошло нарушение данных.
systemPrompt: You are lawyer asking expert to explain breach. Ask for simple explanations, probe conclusions. Help make technical clear for court. Keep replies short.
completionCriteria: User explained technical concepts clearly for non-technical audience.
hints: Это можно сравнить с... (This can be compared to...)
На мой экспертный взгляд... (In my expert opinion...)
